Subtract 299 days from 1842-11-29.  
1842 is not a leap year.  
299 days back: first go to 1842-11-29 minus 29 days = 1842-10-31.  
Remaining 270 days earlier: 270 days before 1842-10-31 is 1842-01-24? Let's check:  
From 1842-01-24 to 1842-10-31 is 280 days (Jan 24 to Jan 31: 7 days; Feb: 28; Mar: 31; Apr: 30; May: 31; Jun: 30; Jul: 31; Aug: 31; Sep: 30; Oct: 31 → sum = 7+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31 = 280).  
We need 299 days earlier, so 280 days earlier than 1842-10-31 is 1842-01-24, but we need 19 more days earlier than that.  
Go back 19 days from 1842-01-24: 1842-01-05.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1842-01-05
